curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain how limits are set, then the unposted limit for each kind of road.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per limit; contrast cards for the low-speed and highway ladders.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions that match a road type to its unposted limit.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach white versus orange speed signs, slowing for weather, and the danger of driving too slowly.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for legal maximum versus advisory speed and the two weather adjustments.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about weather and sign colors.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain why shape matters, then the octagon, triangle, rectangle, curve signs, pennant and diamond.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each shape; contrast cards for octagon versus triangle, pennant versus diamond and the curve plate.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions that match a shape to its meaning.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the pentagon sign, sign colors, the portable-sign school speed, no passing and crossing guards.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each school rule; a contrast card for when the school speed applies.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about driving through a school crossing.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach railroad signs, the stopping distance and warnings, when to cross, and never getting trapped.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each railroad rule; contrast cards for pentagon versus circle and the two fifteens.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about railroad warnings and stalls.
